protocol.roll_window: First 20 observed active civil-session dates starting at each fixed roll, including incomplete/holiday observed sessions. Last window truncated at dataset end. Check changed trades outside, do not assume references become identical.
protocol.inference: One global Holm family of 16 two-sided centered circular 5-eligible-session bootstrap tests: four strategies x three period mean returns plus four paired common148 improvements. Existing engine bootstrap: 2000 replicates, seed 20261020. Eligible zero-trade days included; calendar gaps not filled. Nominal 95% CIs are not simultaneous. Monthly/direction/roll groups and sensitivities descriptive only.
protocol.cost_definition: 2,4,6 ticks per side at .25 points; fixed $4.50 RT commission; unchanged trade fills and stops. Extra cost only, no new signal simulation.
protocol.outliers: Remove exactly three highest-net trades per strategy/period, tie break by date; no threshold search.

limits: Entire dataset already observed; no independent validation or causal claim.
Holm applies to the 16 listed tests; subgroup and cost/outlier tables are descriptive, not additional p-value searches.
Bootstrap intervals nominal 95%, not simultaneous; 2000 draws and few regimes limit precision.
Higher-cost scenarios alter only costs on identical fills; no market-impact or order-book execution simulation.
Rollover-window concentration also reflects where the reference construction differs; it is not independent evidence of a tradable rollover effect.
Closed-trade drawdown only; strategies not combined as a portfolio.
